players.bio: Adil Aouchiche (French pronunciation: ; born 15 July 2002) is a French professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder
Adrian Tobias Gantenbein (born 18 April 2001) is a Swiss professional footballer who plays as a right-back for 2. Bundesliga club Schalke 04.
Anton-Leander Donkor (born 11 November 1997) is a German professional footballer who plays as a left-back or left winger .
Bryan Lasme (born 14 November 1998) is a French professional footballer who plays as a winger or forward
Christian Pierre Louis Gomis (born 9 August 2000) is a Senegalese professional footballer who plays as a forward

Christopher Antwi-Adjei (born 7 February 1994) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Bundesliga club VfL Bochum. Born in Germany, Antwi-Adjei has represented the Ghana national team.
Dejan Ljubičić (born 8 October 1997) is an Austrian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder.
Dylan Leonard (born 30 August 2007) is an Australian professional soccer player who plays as a central defender

Edin Džeko (born 17 March 1986) is a Bosnian professional footballer who plays as a striker for Bundesliga club Schalke 04 and captains the Bosnia and Herzegovina national team. Nicknamed the "Bosnian Diamond" (Bosnian: Bosanski dijamant) or simply the "Diamond" (Dijamant), he is widely regarded as one of the best strikers of his generation.
Emil Winther Højlund (born 4 January 2005) is a Danish professional footballer who plays as a forward.
Éric Junior Dina Ebimbe (born 21 November 2000) is a French professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Ligue 1 club Brest, on loan from German club Eintracht Frankfurt.
Finn-Dominik Porath (born 23 February 1997) is a German professional footballer who plays as a left midfielder.
Hasan Kuruçay (born 31 August 1997) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back

Hwang Hee-chan is a South Korean professional footballer who plays as a forward for Bundesliga club Schalke 04 on loan from EFL Championship club Wolverhampton Wanderers and the South Korea national team.
Henning Matriciani (born 14 March 2000) is a German footballer who plays as a right-back for 2. Bundesliga club Schalke 04.
Janik Jay Bachmann (born 6 May 1996) is a German professional footballer who plays as a midfielder.

Chukwubuike Junior Adamu (born 6 June 2001) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for Bundesliga club Schalke 04. Born in Nigeria, he plays for the Austria national team. Club career Adamu started his career with the youth team of GSV Wacker. In January 2014 he came to Grazer AK.
Kenan Karaman (born 5 March 1994) is a Turkish professional footballer who plays as a striker for Bundesliga club Schalke 04 and the Turkey national team.

Kevin Müller (born 15 March 1991) is a German professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper Career For the 2013–14 season Müller moved to VfB Stuttgart II. On 10 June 2013 he signed a contract until June 2015 with VfB Stuttgart. On 1 August 2014 he was loaned out to FC Energie Cottbus. Simultaneously he extended his contract with Stuttgart until 2016.

Loris Sven Karius (born 22 June 1993) is a German professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper. Born in Biberach, Karius began his career with Stuttgart before moving to Manchester City in 2009. After two years in Manchester City's youth system, he returned to Germany with Mainz 05.

Maximilian Wöber (born 4 February 1998) is an Austrian footballer who plays as a centre-back or left-back for German Bundesliga club Werder Bremen, on loan from Premier League club Leeds United, and the Austria national team.
Mertcan Ayhan (born 8 September 2006) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back . Born in Germany, he represents Turkey at international youth level.
Miron Muslić (born 14 September 1982) is an Austrian-Bosnian professional football manager and former player who is the current manager of 2. Bundesliga club Schalke 04.
Moussa Sylla (born 25 November 1999) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward or winger for 2. Bundesliga club Schalke 04. Born in France, he plays for the Mali national team.

Nikola Katić (pronounced ; born 10 October 1996) is a Bosnian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for 2. Bundesliga club Schalke 04 and the Bosnia and Herzegovina national team. Katić started his professional career at HNK Stolac, before joining Neretvanac Opuzen in 2014. Two years later he switched to Slaven Belupo.

Robin Everardus Gosens (born 5 July 1994) is a German professional footballer who plays as a left midfielder or left wing-back for Serie A club Fiorentina. He is on loan at Schalke 04 for the 2026-27 season. He also plays for the Germany national team.
Ron Schallenberg (born 6 October 1998) is a German professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder
Satoshi Tanaka (born 13 August 2002) is a Japanese footballer who plays as a midfielder.
Soufiane El-Faouzi (born 13 July 2002) is a German professional footballer who plays as a midfielder
Timo Becker (born 25 March 1997) is a German professional footballer who plays as a centre-back
Tomáš Kalas (born 15 May 1993) is a Czech professional footballer who plays for Schalke 04 and the Czech Republic national team. He plays as a centre-back, but has also been played as a right-back.
Vitalie Becker (born 3 March 2005) is a German professional footballer who plays as a left-back
Zaid Amoussou-Tchibara (born 21 February 2006) is a Togolese professional footballer who plays as a forward .
